mascots.name: Wisp
mascots.description: A little ghost with an oversized hood and a restless ribbon tail.

mascots.name: Moth
mascots.description: A moon moth with enormous folded wings and tiny boots.

mascots.name: Kettle
mascots.description: A pocket tea spirit. Steam curls while the little lid taps.

mascots.name: Mimic
mascots.description: A shy shell creature peeking out of a chunky prompt box.

mascots.name: Orbit
mascots.description: A satellite with a single curious lens and a wandering moon.

mascots.name: Moss
mascots.description: A walking mushroom with a broad speckled cap and short steps.

mascots.name: Bytebat
mascots.description: An alert cave bat with tall ears and a scalloped cape.

mascots.name: Cinder
mascots.description: An ember with a lopsided flame and heavy charcoal boots.

mascots.name: Jelly
mascots.description: A translucent bell with sleepy eyes and four trailing tentacles.

mascots.name: Origami
mascots.description: A folded paper fox with sharp ears and an enormous brush tail.

mascots.name: Imp
mascots.description: A mischievous horned gremlin with a crooked, oversized grin.

mascots.name: Rover
mascots.description: A round-eyed lunar robot on caterpillar tracks. Always rolling.
